entry.title: Apple’s new MacBook Pro has a 24-hour battery and an M5 chip
entry.content: Apple has announced the M5 MacBook Pro, and the headline feature is a battery that Apple says lasts a full day of mixed use. The new chip is built on a 2nm process and brings a lot more GPU cores, which matters for the people who buy these machines for video and 3D work rather than email.
